name: io.github.tonyyang0504/apple_search_ads-mcp
description: Apple Ads (formerly Apple Search Ads) (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, get_report, update_b

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_APPLE_SEARCH_ADS_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Apple Ads API clientId (SEARCHADS.…) shown after uploading your public key under Account Settings > API (https://developer.apple.com/documentation/apple-ads-platform-api/implementing-oauth-for-the-apple-ads-platform-api).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_APPLE_SEARCH_ADS_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: The client secret JWT you sign yourself with your ES256 private key (header kid=keyId; claims sub=clientId, iss=teamId, aud=https://appleid.apple.com, exp at most 180 days after iat). The runtime does not sign it: regenerate and replace it before it expires.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_APPLE_SEARCH_ADS_AP_CONTEXT
environmentVariables.description: The full X-AP-Context header value for ad-account-scoped calls, exactly `adAccountId=<ad account id>` (ids from GET /v1/acls, i.e. list_accounts).
